_comment: Pure data. Editing this file changes which seats routing can pick and how
a project maps to a direction; it never requires a code change.
tiers are ordered strongest first. `base` is the generic seat name; a
direction-specialised seat is named base+direction by workspace convention
(e.g. 孙悟空 + 游戏 = 孙悟空游戏), which is how routing resolves one without
a second lookup table. A tier whose seat does not exist in the workspace is
skipped at candidate-build time rather than failing the call.
The rung order is the strength each base seat declares in its own agent
instructions (最强 / 强 / 中 / 弱). Two seats sharing a declared label are
ordered by model strength, which is the only tie-break applied here.
KNOWN DRIFT (DENE-638): 贝吉塔 declares 中 but runs the same
command-code2/deepseek-v4.1-flash as 比克 (弱), while 克林 (弱) runs the
stronger gpt-5.6-luna. The 中 rung is therefore not actually stronger than
the 弱 rungs below it. Resolving that means changing a seat's model or its
declared strength — a roster decision, not a ladder edit — so this file
records the declared order rather than inventing a different one.
_projects_comment: project name -> direction. A project absent from this map, or an issue with
no project at all, routes to the generic (undirected) rung of the ladder;
the decision comment says the direction is unknown rather than guessing one.
Only projects whose direction is unambiguous from the project itself are
listed. The remaining live projects — Nexus-GPU, AI100, bnb contract,
RelayVPS, tarot, ego-lens, Multica 魔改, Agent mono仓库管理 — are left out on
purpose: a wrong direction sends work to a seat carrying the wrong domain
